hints.title: Building the AprilTagProcessor
hints.content: Create it with the builder: `AprilTagProcessor aprilTag = new AprilTagProcessor.Builder().build();`. Store the reference — you will use it later to call getDetectionCount().

hints.title: Building the VisionPortal
hints.content: Use `new VisionPortal.Builder().setCamera(hardwareMap.get(WebcamName.class, "Webcam 1")).addProcessor(aprilTag).build()`. Make sure to call setCamera() before build() or you will get an exception.

hints.title: Reading and displaying the state
hints.content: Call `portal.getPortalState()` which returns a `VisionPortal.PortalState` enum value. Use `telemetry.addData("State", portal.getPortalState())` — telemetry will call toString() on the enum, printing "RUNNING".
